# Grapple/Rope Mechanic — Full Codebase Analysis

I conducted a thorough search of the entire `Assets/` directory for all files related to the grapple/rope/hook mechanic. There are **no** files with "grapple" or "hook" in their filenames, but there is a complete **Rope Lasso** system (winch grapple) implemented under `Assets/Flynn/`. Below is every relevant file and its role.

---

## Core Motor — The Rope Lasso Controller

**`C:\Users\DriveSIM\Documents\GitHub\unity_dev_space\Assets\Flynn\Scripts\Player\RopeLassoController.cs`**
The central grapple motor. Hold **Q** to charge (with reticle feedback), release to fire. Uses a **LineRenderer** (`_ropeLine`) to draw a rope from the player's hand to the far end while reeling. Two modes:
  → **RopeAnchor** → reel the **player** to the exact clicked surface point (self-pull).
  → **RopePullable** → reel a **movable object** toward the player.
  - Force-based (AddForce) so it composes with physics.
  - Blocked by mud/terrain (`BlocksRope` flag in `TerrainState`).
  - Requires the **Wrench** as the active item.
  - Publishes `RopeGrappleStarted`/`RopeGrappleEnded` and `RopePullStarted`/`RopePullEnded` events via `GameEventBus`.
  - Spends battery: flat cost on start + continuous drain per second during pull.

**`C:\Users\DriveSIM\Documents\GitHub\unity_dev_space\Assets\Flynn\Scripts\Player\RopeLassoConfig.cs`**
ScriptableObject with all tunable values: charge time (0.3s), min/max range (2–6 units), pull force (45), max pull speed (12), stop radius (0.8), pull timeout (2s), and steering suppression during self-pull (0.1).

**`C:\Users\DriveSIM\Documents\GitHub\unity_dev_space\Assets\Flynn\Configs\Player\RopeLassoConfig.asset`**
The concrete asset instance with values: chargeTime=0.3, minRange=2, maxRange=6, pullForce=45, maxPullSpeed=12, stopRadius=0.8, pullTimeout=2, steeringDuringPull=0.1.

---

## Target Markers — Anchors & Pullables

**`C:\Users\DriveSIM\Documents\GitHub\unity_dev_space\Assets\Flynn\Scripts\Player\RopeAnchor.cs`**
Marks a world object the lasso can latch onto. Any solid collider works (no trigger volumes). Provides a **"Q → Grapple"** interaction prompt via `IInteractionPromptProvider`. Has an `AnchorType` enum (Stub, Stone, Rock) for cosmetic/future tuning.

**`C:\Users\DriveSIM\Documents\GitHub\unity_dev_space\Assets\Flynn\Scripts\Player\RopePullable.cs`**
Marks a movable object the rope can reel toward the player. Requires a `Rigidbody` and collider. Also provides a **"Q → Grapple"** prompt. `RopeLassoController` reads `Body` (the Rigidbody) for force application.

---

## Mouse Aiming — Target Resolution

**`C:\Users\DriveSIM\Documents\GitHub\unity_dev_space\Assets\Flynn\Scripts\Player\PlayerMouseAimer.cs`**
Single-responsibility aimer that resolves what's under the mouse cursor each frame. For grapple specifically:
  - `HoveredAnchor` (RopeAnchor), `HoveredPullable` (RopePullable), `HoveredGrapplePoint` (Vector3 surface hit point)
  - Uses a single union raycast via `MousePointer` so closest object wins across all interaction layers.
  - Range-gating for grapple is left to `RopeLassoController` (not done here).
  - Builds a unified `PlayerAimHoverResult` struct each frame.

**`C:\Users\DriveSIM\Documents\GitHub\unity_dev_space\Assets\Flynn\Scripts\Player\PlayerAimHoverResult.cs`**
Data struct holding all hovered targets in one packet. Contains `RopeAnchor`, `RopePullable`, `GrapplePoint`, and other interaction fields.

**`C:\Users\DriveSIM\Documents\GitHub\unity_dev_space\Assets\Flynn\Scripts\Player\InteractionPrompt.cs`**
Generic prompt system. For grapple, it renders as `"[Q]  Grapple"`. Both `RopeAnchor` and `RopePullable` implement `IInteractionPromptProvider` and return this prompt.

---

## Visual System
